## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!sales` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html, htmlJson } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const data = {
  "title": "Daily sales · Example Store",
  "period": "8–14 Sep 2026",
  "currency": "IDR",
  "locale": "id-ID",
  "labels": [
    "Mon",
    "Tue",
    "Wed",
    "Thu",
    "Fri",
    "Sat",
    "Sun"
  ],
  "values": [
    3250000,
    4100000,
    3875000,
    4620000,
    5980000,
    7240000,
    6150000
  ],
  "change": 12.4,
  "changeLabel": "vs previous 7 days"
}

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --pink: #ff4f8b; --orange: #ff8a3d; --yellow: #ffc93c; --lime: #9be15d; --mint: #2ed8a7; --sky: #38b6ff; --violet: #7c5cff; --ink: #1d1442; --cream: #fff8ec; --muted: #5b5380; --grid: #3a2f66; --soft: #c9c2ef; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  [hidden] { display: none !important; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(150deg, var(--violet), var(--sky)); color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; padding: 10px; user-select: none; }
  .card { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--cream); border-radius: 22px; padding: 12px 14px; box-shadow: 0 5px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .22); }
  .head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
  .head span { min-width: 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .head span + span { flex: none; max-width: 48%; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e9e1ff; color: var(--ink); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .head span + span:empty { display: none; }
  .total { margin-top: 4px; font-size: clamp(26px, 8vw, 32px); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .change { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .change b { display: inline-block; margin-right: 2px; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e9e1ff; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 800; }
  .change b.up { background: var(--mint); }
  .change b.down { background: var(--pink); }
  .plot { flex: 1; min-height: 0; margin-top: 8px; position: relative; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #5b3fd6; }
  canvas { position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 8px; width: calc(100% - 16px); height: calc(100% - 12px); display: block; touch-action: manipulation; cursor: pointer; }
  canvas:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 8px; }
  .readout { margin-top: 12px; min-height: 38px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ece4ff; font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .readout span { min-width: 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; color: var(--muted); }
  .readout.on span { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
  .readout b { flex: none; font-weight: 800; font-size: 16px; }
  .readout.on b { animation: pop .25s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.6, .5, 1); }
  @keyframes pop { from { transform: scale(.7); } to { transform: scale(1); } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .readout.on b { animation: none; } }
</style>
<main class="card">
  <div class="head"><span id="title"></span><span id="period"></span></div>
  <div class="total" id="total"></div>
  <div class="change" id="change"></div>
  <div class="plot"><canvas id="chart" tabindex="0" role="img"></canvas></div>
  <div class="readout" id="readout" aria-live="polite"><span id="readLabel"></span><b id="readValue"></b></div>
</main>
<script>
  var DATA = ${htmlJson(data)};
  var TEXT = {
    title: 'Sales',
    hint: 'Tap a bar to see its value',
    noData: 'No data',
    noDataShort: 'n/a',
    noValues: 'No sales data to chart',
    change: function (label) { return ' ' + (label || 'vs previous period'); },
    flat: 'No change'
  };
  var d = DATA || {};
  var values = Array.isArray(d.values) ? d.values.map(function (v) { return typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) ? v : null; }) : [];
  var labels = values.map(function (v, i) { return Array.isArray(d.labels) && d.labels[i] != null ? String(d.labels[i]) : String(i + 1); });
  var selected = -1;
  var canvas = document.getElementById('chart');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  function formats(currency, locale) {
    var loc = locale || undefined, money, compact;
    try { new Intl.NumberFormat(loc); } catch (e) { loc = undefined; }
    try { money = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { style: 'currency', currency: currency, currencyDisplay: 'code' }); }
    catch (e) {
      var plain = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      money = { format: function (v) { return (currency ? currency + ' ' : '') + plain.format(v); } };
    }
    try { compact = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1 }); }
    catch (e) { compact = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }); }
    return { money: function (v) { return money.format(v); }, compact: function (v) { return compact.format(v); } };
  }
  var fmt = formats(d.currency, d.locale);

  function niceStep(max, count) {
    var raw = max / count, mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log(raw) / Math.LN10)), f = raw / mag;
    return (f <= 1 ? 1 : f <= 2 ? 2 : f <= 5 ? 5 : 10) * mag;
  }

  function color(name) { return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim(); }

  function layout() {
    var w = canvas.clientWidth, h = canvas.clientHeight;
    var max = 0;
    values.forEach(function (v) { if (v !== null && v > max) max = v; });
    var step = max > 0 ? niceStep(max, 4) : 1;
    var top = Math.max(step, Math.ceil(max / step) * step);
    ctx.font = '12px system-ui, sans-serif';
    var ticks = [], axis = 0;
    for (var t = 0; t <= top + step / 2; t += step) {
      var text = fmt.compact(t);
      ticks.push({ value: t, text: text });
      axis = Math.max(axis, ctx.measureText(text).width);
    }
    var left = Math.ceil(axis) + 10, padTop = 8, padBottom = 22;
    return { w: w, h: h, top: top, ticks: ticks, left: left, y0: padTop, plotH: h - padTop - padBottom, slot: (w - left) / Math.max(1, values.length) };
  }

  var RAINBOW = ['--pink', '--orange', '--yellow', '--lime', '--mint', '--sky', '--violet'];
  var grow = 1;

  function barColor(i) {
    var t = values.length > 1 ? i / (values.length - 1) : 0;
    return color(RAINBOW[Math.round(t * (RAINBOW.length - 1))]);
  }

  function draw() {
    var dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    var L = layout();
    canvas.width = Math.round(L.w * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(L.h * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, L.w, L.h);
    ctx.font = '12px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    if (!values.length) {
      ctx.fillStyle = color('--soft');
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(TEXT.noValues, L.w / 2, L.h / 2);
      return;
    }

    L.ticks.forEach(function (tick) {
      var y = Math.round(L.y0 + L.plotH * (1 - tick.value / L.top)) + 0.5;
      ctx.strokeStyle = color('--grid');
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(L.left, y);
      ctx.lineTo(L.w, y);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = color('--soft');
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.fillText(tick.text, L.left - 8, y);
    });

    var barW = Math.min(36, L.slot * 0.68);
    values.forEach(function (v, i) {
      var cx = L.left + L.slot * i + L.slot / 2;
      var active = i === selected;
      if (v === null) {
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillStyle = color('--soft');
        ctx.fillText(TEXT.noDataShort, cx, L.y0 + L.plotH - 9, L.slot - 2);
      } else {
        var bh = Math.max(2, L.plotH * v / L.top * grow);
        var x = cx - barW / 2, y = L.y0 + L.plotH - bh;
        ctx.fillStyle = barColor(i);
        ctx.globalAlpha = selected === -1 || active ? 1 : 0.35;
        ctx.beginPath();
        if (ctx.roundRect) ctx.roundRect(x, y, barW, bh, [Math.min(9, barW / 2, bh), Math.min(9, barW / 2, bh), 0, 0]);
        else ctx.rect(x, y, barW, bh);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        // The picked bar also gets a white outline, so the selection reads without relying on its color.
        if (active) {
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
          ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.font = (active ? '800 ' : '600 ') + '12px system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = active ? '#ffffff' : color('--soft');
      ctx.fillText(labels[i], cx, L.h - 9, L.slot - 2);
      ctx.font = '12px system-ui, sans-serif';
    });
  }

  // Bars bounce up once on open; reduced motion draws them at full height straight away.
  function intro() {
    if (!values.length || (window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)) return draw();
    var t0 = 0;
    function frame(ts) {
      if (!t0) t0 = ts;
      var t = Math.min(1, (ts - t0) / 650), c = 1.1;
      grow = selected === -1 && t < 1 ? 1 + (c + 1) * Math.pow(t - 1, 3) + c * Math.pow(t - 1, 2) : 1;
      draw();
      if (grow !== 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  function readout() {
    var label = document.getElementById('readLabel');
    var value = document.getElementById('readValue');
    document.getElementById('readout').className = selected === -1 ? 'readout' : 'readout on';
    if (selected === -1) {
      label.textContent = values.length ? TEXT.hint : TEXT.noValues;
      value.textContent = '';
      return;
    }
    label.textContent = labels[selected];
    value.textContent = values[selected] === null ? TEXT.noData : fmt.money(values[selected]);
  }

  function select(i) {
    if (!values.length) return;
    selected = Math.max(0, Math.min(values.length - 1, i));
    draw();
    readout();
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    var L = layout();
    var x = e.clientX - canvas.getBoundingClientRect().left;
    if (x < L.left) return;
    select(Math.floor((x - L.left) / L.slot));
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { select(selected + 1); e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { select(selected === -1 ? values.length - 1 : selected - 1); e.preventDefault(); }
  });

  document.getElementById('title').textContent = d.title || TEXT.title;
  document.getElementById('period').textContent = d.period || '';

  var known = values.filter(function (v) { return v !== null; });
  var total = typeof d.total === 'number' ? d.total : known.length ? known.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) : null;
  var totalEl = document.getElementById('total');
  totalEl.textContent = total === null ? 'Not available' : fmt.money(total);
  if (total === null) totalEl.style.color = 'var(--muted)';

  var pct = typeof d.change === 'number' ? d.change : null;
  if (pct === null && typeof d.previousTotal === 'number' && d.previousTotal > 0 && total !== null) pct = (total - d.previousTotal) / d.previousTotal * 100;
  var changeEl = document.getElementById('change');
  if (pct === null) {
    changeEl.hidden = true;
  } else {
    var badge = document.createElement('b');
    var rounded = Math.round(pct * 10) / 10;
    badge.className = rounded > 0 ? 'up' : rounded < 0 ? 'down' : '';
    badge.textContent = rounded === 0 ? TEXT.flat : (rounded > 0 ? '▲ +' : '▼ −') + Math.abs(rounded).toFixed(1) + '%';
    changeEl.appendChild(badge);
    changeEl.appendChild(document.createTextNode(TEXT.change(d.changeLabel)));
  }

  canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Bar chart: ' + labels.map(function (l, i) { return l + ' ' + (values[i] === null ? TEXT.noData : fmt.money(values[i])); }).join(', '));
  // Long amounts shrink to fit rather than being cut off, since a clipped number would misstate it.
  function fitText(el, min) {
    el.style.fontSize = '';
    var size = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize);
    while (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth && size > min) { size -= 1; el.style.fontSize = size + 'px'; }
  }
  intro();
  readout();
  fitText(totalEl, 16);
  addEventListener('resize', function () { draw(); fitText(totalEl, 16); });
</script>
`

client.command('sales', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Sales Chart",
    height: 360,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "The sales chart opens on WhatsApp Android only.",
  })
})
```

| | |
| --- | --- |

| Input | Tap |

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
